millie-morning-greeting.speaker: Aunt Millie
millie-morning-greeting.text: There you are, sleepyhead! Thomas is already out by the mill, and I laid out some supplies for you in the house.

millie-give-chest-key.speaker: Aunt Millie
millie-give-chest-key.text: Here, take this chest key. Open the storage chest inside my room and grab everything you need before heading out.

choices.label: Thanks! I'll open the chest now.

millie-chores-reminder.speaker: Aunt Millie
millie-chores-reminder.text: Once you've got your gear from the chest, I hope you'll head outside and take care of your chores. Thomas will be glad for the help.
